findings.title: OptimizedCursorPaginator crashes on datetime sort field in OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint
findings.body: `OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint.get` paginates `AuditLogEntry` with `order_by="-datetime"` using `OptimizedCursorPaginator`. Unlike `DateTimePaginator`, `OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_item_key` passes `getattr(item, self.key)` directly to `math.floor` / `math.ceil`, which raises `TypeError: must be real number, not datetime.datetime` whenever any audit log rows are returned. Additionally, `value_from_cursor` returns the numeric cursor value without converting it back to a `datetime`, breaking subsequent cursor queries against the `datetime` column.

findings.title: Negative slice bounds on Django QuerySet raise ValueError
findings.body: `OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result` (and `BasePaginator.get_result` at line 184 when `cursor.is_prev` is True) passes a negative `start_offset` (and potentially negative `stop`) into `queryset[start_offset:stop]` when `cursor.offset < 0`. Django's `QuerySet.__getitem__` does not support negative indexing and immediately raises `ValueError: Negative indexing is not supported.`, causing an unhandled 500 error whenever a cursor with a negative offset is supplied.

findings.title: Potential AttributeError when organization_context.member is None
findings.body: `organization_context.member` can be `None` for non-superuser requests authenticated via organization-level tokens or integrations. Accessing `organization_context.member.has_global_access` without checking that `organization_context.member` is not `None` will raise an `AttributeError`.
